title: Scale
tagline: A seed-driven, walkable, living and destructible 3D city in the browser — every seed is a different place.
description:
Every seed builds a different city — a walkable, living place of people, traffic, weather and landmarks, all generated in your browser.

You wake into it with powers. Bend the city, fight the Strider, or just roam: the systems around you — crime, police, an army, an underground slime civilisation — keep moving whether you act or not.
highlights: Procedurally generated 3D city — every seed a new world
The Strider: a giant living threat the whole city responds to
Living systems — crime, justice, army, factions
Underground slime civilisation beneath the streets
Music, saves, and NPCs with personalities
